invariants: Final re-entry revalidates the exact root provider binding/receipt and requires provider current floor to equal the root receipt sequence; a later provider head makes the root stale.
Verified SignerTrustSnapshot.snapshot_id must equal ClockEpochRoot.trust_snapshot_id before signed authority can authorize re-entry.
clock_key_epoch is security-relevant in V04 and must match a typed ReentryTrustBinding whose SHA-256 fingerprint matches the supplied clock key material.
Fresh Mission binding and otherwise-valid authority signature cannot bypass provider-head, trust-snapshot, or key-identity mismatch.
Re-entry remains neutral: zero Experience, zero operational progress, zero appraisal/personality/trauma-relief delta, no stale pressure or prior terminal-hold carryover.
production_limits: Synthetic keys/providers and durability-domain labels are not production HSM/TPM/remote-provider proof.
V04 fingerprint proves equality to supplied synthetic key material only; protected key storage and hardware-backed identity remain external evidence requirements.
